headline: U.S., Venezuela strike oil deal. And, the staggering hidden toll of U.S. heat deaths
context: The U.S. and Venezuela have entered into an oil deal. And, NPR spent two years tracking heat-related deaths and found that people in the U.S. are dying from heat more than the official counts show.
